name: Online Archive of California
description: Free access to detailed descriptions of primary resource collections from over 350 libraries, archives, historical societies, and museums throughout California
fullDescription: The Online Archive of California provides free access to more than 60,000 collection guides (finding aids) from over 350 California libraries, archives, and museums.
whatTheyOffer:
- 60,000+ collection guides to archival collections
- Primary source materials
- Collections from 350+ institutions
- Photographs and documents
- Historical records
- Free to search and browse
howToGetIt:
1. Visit oac.cdlib.org
2. Search or browse collections by topic or institution
3. Find detailed descriptions of archival materials
4. Identify materials of interest
5. Contact holding institution for access to originals
keywords: Online Archive of California, OAC, finding aids, primary sources, archives, historical records, photographs, documents, California history
